sun.java2d.pipe

类 PixelToParallelogramConverter

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.java2d.pipe.PixelToShapeConverter
      • sun.java2d.pipe.PixelToParallelogramConverter
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    PixelDrawPipe, PixelFillPipe, ShapeDrawPipe

    public class PixelToParallelogramConverter
extends PixelToShapeConverter
implements ShapeDrawPipe
    This class converts calls to the basic pixel rendering methods into calls to the methods on a ParallelogramPipe. Most calls are transformed into calls to the fill(Shape) method by the parent PixelToShapeConverter class, but some calls are transformed into calls to fill/drawParallelogram().

    • 构造器详细资料

      • PixelToParallelogramConverter

        public PixelToParallelogramConverter(ShapeDrawPipe shapepipe,
                                     ParallelogramPipe pgrampipe,
                                     double minPenSize,
                                     double normPosition,
                                     boolean adjustfill)
        参数:
        shapepipe - pipeline to forward shape calls to
        pgrampipe - pipeline to forward parallelogram calls to (and drawLine calls if possible)
        minPenSize - minimum pen size for dropout control
        normPosition - sub-pixel location to normalize endpoints for STROKE_NORMALIZE cases
        adjustFill - boolean to control whethere normalization constants are also applied to fill operations (normally true for non-AA, false for AA)

        public void fillOuterParallelogram(SunGraphics2D sg2d,
                                   double ux1,

                                   double lw1,
                                   double lw2)
        This utility function handles the case where a drawRectangle operation discovered that the interior hole in the rectangle or parallelogram has been completely filled in by the stroke width. It calculates the outer parallelogram of the stroke and issues a single fillParallelogram request to fill it.
